# ByteVerse — Full context for LLMs

> ByteVerse is a forever-free AI microlearning content generator. Founded by Dhanikesh "Dhani" Karunanithi (https://dhanikeshkarunanithi.com), it helps educators create and export pedagogy-first modules. Sudar (https://teachwithsudar.com) is the optional sibling product for adaptive delivery.

## What ByteVerse is

ByteVerse is a **microlearning content factory** for L&D professionals, educators, and subject-matter experts.

- Chat-first brief: talk through goals, upload PDFs and URLs, paste text with RAG over sources
- Output: **3–7 minute modules** with visible pedagogy (ADDIE, Bloom's taxonomy, cognitive load)
- **ByteAI** is an instructional design engine — structure, objectives, assessments — not a learner tutor
- Ends at **export**: SCORM 1.2, standalone HTML, JSON source
- **Forever free**: ByteVerse will always be free. ByteVerse AI is included free and unlimited. Bring your own API keys for Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Mistral, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, and more.

## What ByteVerse is not

- Not a full learning management system
- Not Sudar Learn, Sudar Studio, or Sudar Intelligence
- Does not promise adaptive delivery, digital learner twin, or memory-aware tutoring (those are Sudar capabilities)

## Founder

Dhanikesh "Dhani" Karunanithi is the founder of ByteVerse and Sudar. Personal site: https://dhanikeshkarunanithi.com

His mission: make AI-powered education more open, free, and accessible. From learners in remote communities to professionals upskilling at scale — no one should be left behind in the knowledge economy.

## Open inter-tech ecosystem

| Step | Product |
|------|---------|
| Create microlearning module | **ByteVerse** |
| Export SCORM / HTML / JSON | **ByteVerse** |
| Import, publish, adapt | **Sudar** (or any LMS) |

ByteVerse does **not** require Sudar. Sudar is promoted as the recommended host for adaptive delivery after export.

### Deploy with Sudar (manual handoff)

1. In ByteVerse, finish a module and open Export.
2. Download SCORM 1.2 ZIP (or standalone HTML).
3. In Sudar Studio (https://teachwithsudar.com), sign in and use Import SCORM.
4. Edit if needed, publish to Sudar Learn for learners.

### Export formats

| Format | Use case |
|--------|----------|
| SCORM 1.2 ZIP | Sudar Studio, Moodle, Canvas, etc. |
| HTML ZIP | Standalone hosting, email, intranet |
| JSON | Re-open project in ByteVerse |

## Crawler policy

Public marketing pages (/, /about, /showcase, /signup, /login) are intended for search and AI discovery. Authenticated creator workspace (/app/*), API routes (/api/*), admin, and analytics are disallowed in robots.txt.
